title: An Octopus Has Three Hearts (And Blue Blood)
description:
Three hearts, blue blood, and one heart that stops when it swims. The octopus is stranger than you think.

#shorts #animalfacts #octopus #ocean

scenes.text: An octopus has three hearts, and its blood is blue.
Two of those hearts pump blood through the gills. The third pumps it around the rest of the body.
But when an octopus swims, that third heart stops beating.
That's one reason octopuses would rather crawl than swim. Swimming wears them out fast.
And their blood is blue because it carries oxygen using copper instead of iron.
